name: TCL 50DP660
summary: TCL 50DP660 ships with recommendation rows, T-Channel tiles and preloaded apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This European TCL runs Android TV 8.0. The stock home carries recommendation rows and T-Channel content tiles. It also has TCL's MagiConnect mirroring, an Alexa bridge, an app store, a media centre and start-up service, factory test leftovers, and Google extras such as Play Movies and games.

The list was applied on a real TV and survived several reboots. TidyTV turns the apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything, so each one can be switched back on. The Live TV, tuner, HDMI and AV apps are kept.
keep: Live TV, the tuner input, HDMI and AV
TCL settings, remote pairing and virtual keys
notes: This set has no microphone, so Assistant and voice search are on the list.
Never use the factory menu's NVM reset. It wipes the Wi-Fi address and Netflix identity, and only a full firmware reflash fixes it.
The stock home has priority on this firmware, so a replacement home screen only takes over once the stock one is off.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 50DP660?
faq.a: This set has no microphone, so there is no voice button to lose.
Chromecast is kept. MagiConnect screen mirroring is on the list and is switched off.
The TCL OTA updater is on the list. Turn it back on in the app when you want to check for a firmware update.
